name: Mad Labs - 2g Disposable - Peach Rings
description:
Sweet, juicy, and candy-shop nostalgic. The Mad Labs Peach Rings disposable delivers a full 2 grams of premium oil in a sleek, ready-to-go device — no charging setup, no cartridges, no fuss. Just pick it up and pull.

Peach Rings nails that classic gummy-candy flavor: ripe, juicy peach up front with a sweet, tangy sugar-coated finish that keeps every pull fun and full of taste. It's a flavor-forward crowd-pleaser made for anyone who likes their sessions easy, breezy, and packed with that unmistakable peachy sweetness.

Why you'll love it:

2G of premium oil — long-lasting and built to go the distance
Rechargeable, all-in-one design — draw-activated, pocket-friendly, zero maintenance
Bold Peach Rings flavor — juicy ripe peach with a sweet, tangy candy finish
Smooth, consistent pulls — flavorful from the first draw to the last

Big flavor, dependable performance, and effortless convenience in one compact device. Mad Labs Peach Rings is ready whenever you are.
